game.name: Disney Universe (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,Nl,Sv,No,Da)
game.desc: Disney Universe is an action/adventure game for Xbox 360. Playable by 4 players in cooperation, the software allows you to evolve in different Disney universes such as Alice in Wonderland or Monsters & Co. The title offers the player more than 40 costumes inspired by the company's famous characters, each with specific abilities.
